data.description:
## Context
A documentation-only Gerrit change currently consumes the complete OS/Python pytest matrix, mutation, packaging, optionality, identity, eval, and golden-path jobs even though no executable or configuration behavior changed. The operator explicitly approved a reduced docs-only lane, but configuration and workflow changes must always be treated as code-impacting. The classifier must therefore be fail-closed and allowlist only unambiguously documentary paths. The reduced lane must retain every documentation-related guard, including generated-doc drift, ADR numbering/index/reference validation, docs index completeness, README quickstart/reference checks, CLI/MCP reference drift, env registry drift, and any other documentation guard discovered in the current shared workflow.

## Plan
- Inventory the shared Verify workflow and classify every existing gate as documentation-relevant or full-code-only; record the mapping in tests so forgotten doc gates cannot silently disappear.
- Add a deterministic changed-path classifier for the exact Gerrit patchset. Only allowlisted documentation artifacts select the reduced lane. Any Python, shell, workflow, action, dependency/lock, build, test, fixture, config, policy, or unrecognized path selects the full lane. Empty, malformed, or unavailable diffs also select the full lane.
- Route docs-only patchsets through one Ubuntu documentation gate job. Reuse a single documentation-gate definition shared with the full lane so generated-doc, drift, index, link/reference, and quickstart validation cannot diverge.
- Skip the pytest OS/Python matrix and unrelated mutation, optionality, artifact, eval, golden-path, and identity jobs only when the fail-closed classifier proves the patchset is docs-only.
- Keep the ticket-resolution gate, clear-vote, aggregate vote, and all Gerrit security/trust boundaries unchanged.
- Add workflow/config contract tests for the classifier, the conservative path boundary, complete docs-gate inventory, both docs-only and code/config routing, and fail-closed vote aggregation.
- Measure the docs-only workflow wall clock and runner occupancy against change 1778, then record the first genuine Gerrit observation.
- Back-out is a Gerrit revert restoring unconditional full Verify execution.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A change limited to allowlisted documentation paths selects the docs-only lane.
- [ ] A Python file change selects the full Verify lane.
- [ ] A shell or executable script change selects the full Verify lane.
- [ ] A GitHub workflow or action change selects the full Verify lane.
- [ ] A dependency or lockfile change selects the full Verify lane.
- [ ] A test or fixture change selects the full Verify lane.
- [ ] A repository configuration or policy change selects the full Verify lane.
- [ ] An unrecognized path selects the full Verify lane.
- [ ] An empty or unreadable diff selects the full Verify lane.
- [ ] Docs-only Verify runs ADR number validation.
- [ ] Docs-only Verify runs ADR index drift validation.
- [ ] Docs-only Verify runs ADR cross-reference validation.
- [ ] Docs-only Verify runs docs index completeness validation.
- [ ] Docs-only Verify runs README quickstart validation.
- [ ] Docs-only Verify runs CLI reference drift validation.
- [ ] Docs-only Verify runs MCP reference drift validation.
- [ ] Docs-only Verify runs env-var registry drift validation.
- [ ] Docs-only Verify runs every other current documentation-related guard found by the inventory.
- [ ] The full Verify lane reuses the same documentation-gate definition.
- [ ] Docs-only Verify does not run the OS/Python pytest matrix.
- [ ] Docs-only Verify does not run mutation testing.
- [ ] Docs-only Verify does not run optionality, artifact, eval, golden-path, or identity jobs.
- [ ] The resolvable-ticket gate still runs for docs-only changes.
- [ ] Verified voting remains fail-closed when the classifier or docs gate fails.
- [ ] Workflow policy and config parsing tests pass.
- [ ] Lint and typecheck pass.
- [ ] Gerrit LLM-Review reaches +1.
- [ ] Gerrit Verified reaches +1.
- [ ] The change merges before this ticket closes.
- [ ] A genuine docs-only Gerrit timing and runner-occupancy comparison is recorded.
data.title: Use a docs-only Gerrit Verify lane without losing documentation gates
